all_81_lift_corollary.proof: each matched base coefficient c multiplies the same universal coefficient K_Project=T_HT_corrected; exact-zero rows remain zero

symbolic_proof: m+n+2>=2 and k+ell+1>=1, so the common denominator is nonzero
therefore K_Project=2*T_HT_printed=T_HT_corrected coefficientwise on the full domain
arbitrary_jet_kernel.theorem: for every m,n>=0 and every 0<=k<=m, 0<=ell<=n: K_Project=2*T_HT_printed=T_HT_corrected

derivation: K_Project(e_a; k=0)=2/(3*1)=2/3 on the right output
K_Project(e_a; k=e_a)=2/(3*2)=1/3 on the left output
P_a Delta(U,A) gives 1 on (e_a,0) and 1 on (0,e_a)
Delta(U,P_a A) gives 1/3 on (e_a,0) and 2/3 on (0,e_a)
Delta(P_a U,A)=P_a Delta(U,A)-Delta(U,P_a A) gives 2/3 on (e_a,0) and 1/3 on (0,e_a)
K_Project(e_a; k=0)=2/(3*1)=2/3 on the right output
K_Project(e_a; k=e_a)=2/(3*2)=1/3 on the left output
P_a Delta(U,A) gives 1 on (e_a,0) and 1 on (0,e_a)
Delta(U,P_a A) gives 1/3 on (e_a,0) and 2/3 on (0,e_a)
Delta(P_a U,A)=P_a Delta(U,A)-Delta(U,P_a A) gives 2/3 on (e_a,0) and 1/3 on (0,e_a)
